verdict.rationale: The official site links to a page titled "Get Security Updates for Vue 2" alongside a "Migration from Vue 2" guide, so security updates for the older major version appear to be offered while teams migrate. The evidence is only link titles, with no detail on who provides the updates, how long they last, what they cost, or how to get them. Missing for 10: details of the security-update offering (provider, duration, cost, scope), documentation of how to enroll or receive patches, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
